Extracts Dublin Core metadata from a page

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineObj = try createEngine(config: nil)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.metadata().dcTitle() as Any)
debugPrint(result.metadata().dcCreator() as Any)
```
